title: Record the shared -4 copied into the restored half
body:
## Summary
- Immediately before event 23237, register 18 holds `-4` when register 359 starts at `1`. The data register contributes `0`.
- One addition writes it: event 20575 adds `-2` times register 292, which holds `2`.
- No selected frontier change and no new exponent. The writes that produce register 292 are not traced.
